title: Deliberation & Oratorical Register
goal: Use formal -ra conditional alternatives in civic speeches and parliamentary deliberation

items: I can use formal -ra forms (quisiéramos, debiera, pudiera) and compound hubiera + participle in civic speeches.
I can keep -se forms (quisiese, hubiese) out of conditional result clauses in standard formal Spanish.
I can use parliamentary deliberation, quorum, and public-good vocabulary in C1 discourse.
